benefits.name: Annual Renewal Bonus
benefits.description: 5,000 Virgin Points awarded to the primary accountholder each year the account is renewed.

benefits.name: Personal Perks
benefits.description: Choice of one Personal Perk from Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Hotels, or Virgin Voyages after $15,000 in annual spend, and a second perk after $30,000.
benefits.terms: Spend $15,000 in a card year to choose one perk; spend $30,000 to choose two. Perk options include Virgin Atlantic companion vouchers or cabin upgrades, Virgin Hotels extra nights or suite upgrades, and Virgin Voyages bar credits or packages.

benefits.name: Virgin Hotels Third Night Free
benefits.description: Book two nights and get the third night free at participating Virgin Hotels properties, once a year.
benefits.terms: Valid at participating Virgin Hotels properties. Redeemable once per year.

benefits.name: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club Tier Points
benefits.description: Earn 25 Flying Club Tier Points for every $2,500 spent in a month, up to 50 Tier Points per month.
benefits.terms: 25 Tier Points per $2,500 of monthly spend, capped at 50 Tier Points per month.

benefits.name: Authorized User Bonus Points
benefits.description: 2,500 Virgin Points for each additional cardholder added to the account.
benefits.terms: 2,500 points per added authorized user, up to 10,000 points total.

benefits.name: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: Identity theft monitoring and notification services.

benefits.name: World Elite Concierge
benefits.description: Mastercard World Elite concierge service for travel, dining, and entertainment requests.

earningRates.terms: 3 Virgin Points per $1 on Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Hotels, and Virgin Voyages purchases.
2 Virgin Points per $1. Streaming limited to select services.
1 Virgin Point per $1 everywhere Mastercard is accepted. Points do not expire.
